FIRST OMNIBUS AMENDMENT AND INCREASED FACILITY ACTIVATION NOTICE, DATED AS OF MAY 27, 2026, AMONG CONMED CORPORATION, LINVATEC NEDERLAND B.V
Exhibit 10.1
Execution Version
FIRST OMNIBUS AMENDMENT AND INCREASED FACILITY
ACTIVATION NOTICE
FIRST AMENDMENT AND INCREASED
FACILITY ACTIVATION NOTICE, dated as of May 27, 2026 (this " Amendment "), to (a) the Eighth Amended and Restated Credit
Agreement, dated as of June 10, 2025 (as amended, amended and restated or otherwise modified from time to time prior to the date hereof,
the " Credit Agreement "; the Credit Agreement as modified by this Amendment, the " Amended Credit Agreement "),
among CONMED Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the " Parent Borrower "), the Foreign Subsidiary Borrowers from time
to time party thereto, the Lenders party thereto, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent (the " Administrative Agent "),
and the other agents party thereto and (b) the Amended and Restated Guarantee and Collateral Agreement, dated as of the June 10, 2025
(as amended, amended and restated or otherwise modified from time to time prior to the date hereof, the " Guarantee and Collateral
Agreement "; the Guarantee and Collateral Agreement as modified by this Amendment, the " Amended Guarantee and Collateral
Agreement "), made by the Parent Borrower and its Subsidiaries party thereto in favor of the Administrative Agent. Capitalized
terms used herein and not otherwise defined shall have the meanings assigned to them in the Credit Agreement or the Amended Credit Agreement,
as applicable.
W I T N E S S E T H :
WHEREAS, the Parent Borrower
and the Administrative Agent are parties to the Credit Agreement;
WHEREAS, pursuant to Section
2.28 of the Credit Agreement, the Parent Borrower has requested commitments for Incremental Term Loans in the form of delayed draw term
"a" loans in an aggregate principal amount equal to $450,000,000 on the terms set forth herein (such commitments, the " Term
A-2 Commitments ", the loans pursuant to such Term A-2 Commitments, the " Term A-2 Loans ");
WHEREAS, the Parent Borrower
may incur such Term A-2 Commitments and such Term A-2 Loans by entering into an Increased Facility Activation Notice with Lenders willing
to provide such Term A-2 Commitments (each such Lender, a " Term A-2 Lender " and together the " Term A-2 Lenders ");
WHEREAS, each Term A-2 Lender
listed on Schedule 1 hereby commits to provide Term A-2 Commitments in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed the amount of
its "Term A-2 Commitment" set forth next to such Term A-2 Lender's name on Schedule 1 ;
WHEREAS, pursuant to Section
2.28(d) of the Credit Agreement, amendments to the Credit Agreement necessary to reflect the existence and terms of any Incremental Term
Loans may be effected in writing by the Administrative Agent with the Parent Borrower's consent;
WHEREAS, the Parent Borrower
has requested certain other amendments to the Credit Agreement and the Guarantee and Collateral Agreement;
WHEREAS, pursuant to Section
10.1 of the Credit Agreement, the Credit Agreement may be amended in writing signed by the Parent Borrower and the Required Lenders (as
defined in the Credit Agreement);
WHEREAS, the Parent Borrower,
the Administrative Agent, each Lender party to the Credit Agreement prior to giving effect to his Amendment that is a signatory hereto
(each a " Consenting Lender ") and each Term A-2 Lender is willing to consent to the amendments, waivers and other modifications
set forth herei
